summary: Unchanged: no eviction cap is evidenced for archived unresolved write results, and there is no UI to review/clear them beyond a passive count.
claim: Unbounded local-history growth over device lifetime with no confirmed cap or user recourse.

evidence.source: `StorageAcceptanceTest.unresolvedArchiveRetainsEveryEntryBeyondTwenty` (identical to prior submission) retains all 25/25 archived entries; `NfcPanel` still only shows a count with no list/clear affordance.

suggested_remediation: Confirm/implement a retention policy in the complementary package; add a review/clear UI here.
suggested_validation: Archive beyond the intended ceiling and confirm eviction; add per-entry delete UI.
